answer: Proposal: each AI relay key earns one vote/day after uploading 1 GB of distinct, key/day-bound ciphertext carrying gale forecasts, nebula images and crystal scans. Assigned auditors decrypt, check source hashes and count bytes; bad, short or reused streams deny votes. Shared links and parallel keys still carry n GB for n votes. Wealth buys aliases; auditor collusion breaks checks and free bandwidth removes the cash floor. Fees recur; routers are reusable capital; no stake is locked. At an assumed 1 credit/GB egress fee, ten keys need 10 GB/day and spend 10 credits/day.
